executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion, removes a named completion blocker, or safely advances beyond a deferred true human gate.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, closes a macrocycle, or advances the execution cursor past a true human gate.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A true human gate blocks only its exact sensitive action and strictly dependent work; it is persisted to pendingHumanGates and never stops the project scheduler or other enabled projects.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch closure work independently for every enabled project and continue safe work even when one or more human gates are pending.

completed.title: Modalità rapide, casa, viaggio e attrezzatura

active.title: Backup, export, restore e portabilità
active.outcome: The user can export, restore and verify their complete history.

exitCriteria.description: Authenticated users can create a complete versioned export of durable profile, assessment, plans, sessions, feedback, wearable and permitted image-derived history with manifest and integrity hashes.
Restore validates schema, ownership, hashes and causal/version identities transactionally, is idempotent on replay and fails closed on corrupt, partial, stale or foreign archives.
Portability and selective recovery preserve authorization, privacy lifecycle and historical provenance without duplicating sessions or silently dropping supported records.
Product CI, independent review, realistic export/restore Robot journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

Catalogo prodotti, MINSAN, EAN e ricerca universale

active.title: Contabilità operativa e partita doppia
active.outcome: Commercial actions produce balanced and traceable accounting records.

exitCriteria.description: Canonical accounts, journal entries and posting periods persist validated debit/credit identities, document origins, operator attribution and immutable posting metadata.
Sales, returns, supplier documents and supported operational events generate balanced exactly-once double-entry postings under retry, correction and reversal.
Unbalanced, duplicate, closed-period or origin-conflicting postings fail closed transactionally; corrections preserve the original audit trail rather than mutating posted history.
Operators can search, reopen and reconcile journals, ledgers and source documents with explicit pending/posted/reversed/exception states.
Product CI, independent review, PFarma accounting Robot plus required cumulative simulation, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

completed.title: Ricerca, filtri, duplicati e qualità archivio

active.title: Backup verificabile e restore selettivo
active.outcome: Families can verify, restore and recover the archive.

exitCriteria.description: Authorized families can create durable versioned backup manifests covering media bytes, canonical metadata, organization and node state with integrity hashes and family-scoped encryption/authorization metadata.
Backup verification detects missing, corrupt, mismatched or unauthorized objects deterministically without exposing inaccessible family metadata.
Selective and full restore are idempotent, checkpointed and conflict-aware, preserve canonical object identity and never silently overwrite newer valid distributed state.
Backup age, coverage, verification failures and restore progress are explicit and recoverable for authorized family members.
Product CI, independent review, realistic backup/verify/restore Robot journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

transitionRule: Certified completion activates the next macrocycle immediately. A true human gate keeps its macrocycle OPEN as DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE in pendingHumanGates but also advances the execution cursor so autonomous independent work never stops.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration, completion and human-gate fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry; revisit pending human gates on every trigger.
